# fptcloud_object_storage_iam_user_access_key (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reports which access keys the user holds and when they were created. Secrets
# are never part of the listing - the API returns one only at create time.
data "fptcloud_object_storage_iam_user_access_key" "example" {
  vpc_id      = "your_vpc_id"
  region_name = "your_region_name"
  user_name   = "app-backend"
}

output "list_access_key" {
  value = data.fptcloud_object_storage_iam_user_access_key.example.list_access_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region_name` (String) The region name that's are the same with the region name in the S3 service. Currently, we have: HCM-01, HCM-02, HN-01, HN-02
- `user_name` (String) Name of the IAM user whose access keys to list
- `vpc_id` (String) The VPC ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `list_access_key` (List of Object) The IAM user's access keys. Secrets are never included (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--list_access_key))
- `total` (Number) How many access keys the IAM user holds

<a id="nestedatt--list_access_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `list_access_key`

Read-Only:

- `access_key_id` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
